8.6.3.37 StorageCondition
[SWS_Dem_00605] Definition of ClientServerInterface StorageCondition
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04219
⌈
Name
StorageCondition
Comment
Provides the capability to set a storage condition if at least one storage condition is configured.
One port of this interface type is provided per storage condition by the Dem Service
Component. It has StorageConditionId as a port-defined argument.
IsService
true
Variation
–
0
E_OK
Operation successful
Possible Errors
